title: Senior React Developer
jobDescription: We are looking for a Senior React Developer to join the digital banking team at Standard Bank. You will lead the development of modern, scalable front-end solutions that serve millions of customers.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in front-end development
Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript
Experience with Redux or similar state management
Familiarity with GraphQL and REST APIs
Ability to write clean, testable code
responsibilities: Architect and develop high-performance React applications
Collaborate with design and product teams to deliver features
Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers
Optimise applications for maximum speed and scalability
Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines

title: Data Engineer
jobDescription: FNB is seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design and build scalable data pipelines that power our analytics and reporting platforms.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in data engineering
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Hands-on experience with Spark and dbt
Familiarity with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake
Understanding of data modelling best practices
responsibilities: Design, build and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines
Collaborate with data analysts and scientists to deliver data products
Optimise query performance and data storage costs
Ensure data quality and reliability across pipelines
Document data flows and lineage

title: Product Manager – Digital Payments
jobDescription: TymeBank is looking for a Product Manager to drive the strategy and execution of our digital payments products, working cross-functionally to deliver exceptional customer experiences.
requirements: 3+ years of product management experience in fintech or payments
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies
Experience conducting user research and synthesising insights
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Familiarity with payment rails and regulatory landscape
responsibilities: Define and own the product roadmap for digital payments
Collaborate with engineering, design and compliance teams
Translate user research into actionable product requirements
Track and report on key product metrics
Identify and prioritise new product opportunities

title: Cloud Solutions Architect

Deep expertise in AWS and Azure
Hands-on experience with Terraform and Kubernetes
Strong understanding of cloud security and governance

Lead technical discovery workshops with clients
Oversee cloud migration and modernisation engagements

Strong portfolio demonstrating user-centred design process
Experience conducting usability testing and user interviews
Understanding of WCAG accessibility standards
responsibilities: Conduct user research to understand needs and pain points
Create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs in Figma

Run usability tests and iterate based on findings
Contribute to and maintain the design system
benefits: On-site Cape Town office with modern facilities

Integrate with backend REST APIs

Collaborate with cross-functional squads in an Agile environment
